cohort: The cohort consisted of 218 adult patients (over 18 years of age) with type 2 diabetes mellitus, encompassing normal weight, overweight, or obesity, from the metropolitan area of Guadalajara, Mexico.
finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with an earlier age of T2DM diagnosis and increased obesity risk by nine times in patients with T2DM.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was linked to a significantly earlier age of T2DM diagnosis (30.7 years vs. 46.7 years for vaginally born patients) and increased the risk of obesity by nine times in T2DM patients.
